Title: Gulliver's Land: Christmas season
Address: Gulliver's Land, Livingstone Drive, Newlands, Milton Keynes, MK15 0DT
ScheduleText: Open Sundays 22 and 29 Nov 2026, 10:30–16:00 (other November days closed). Home page lists 'Christmas at Gulliver's' 22 Nov – 23 Dec 2026; December opening days not shown
PriceText: Park day ticket £26 online / £29 on the day (adult or child); under 90 cm free
Description: Theme park in Milton Keynes for children about 2–13, with rides and a Christmas season. Far from London
Cons: About 50 miles from London; few opening days; Christmas package details not read
NeedsInfo: Prices and November times from the opening-times page read 2026-11-02. Ages 2–13 from the home page wording (target audience, not an entry rule). December days and what Christmas adds to the ticket not confirmed: check the site
